framework.summary: Before deploying a model, a developer must implement a written safety and security protocol, publish a redacted copy, send it to the attorney general, and review it annually.
framework.quote: (1) implement a written safety and security protocol;

transparency_report.summary: A developer must conspicuously publish a redacted copy of its safety and security protocol and republish it after material changes.
transparency_report.quote: conspicuously publish a copy of the safety and security protocol

incident_reporting.summary: A developer must disclose each safety incident to the attorney general within 72 hours of learning of it.
incident_reporting.quote: model to the attorney general within 72 hours of the date

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: No separate shorter window for imminent-risk incidents.

whistleblower.summary: The bill text is silent on this.

registration.summary: Before deploying, a developer must send a redacted copy of its safety protocol to the attorney general; no licence or approval is required.
registration.quote: redactions, and transmit a copy of the redacted safety and security protocol to the attorney

shutdown.summary: The bill text is silent on this.

compute_threshold.summary: Covers any developer that has trained at least one model; no compute threshold.

harm_threshold.summary: Critical harm means death or serious injury of 25 or more people, or at least $1,000,000 in damages, from a CBRN weapon or autonomous criminal conduct.
